title: Tilt cutoffs χ(z)·t_P(S) are continuous and compactly supported
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, P ∈ G(N,n) and χ : ℝ^N → ℝ continuous with compact support. Then there is f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n), ℝ) with f(z,S) = χ(z)·‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap(projectionLinearMap S − projectionLinearMap P)‖ for all (z,S), and tsupport f ⊆ tsupport χ × G(N,n). Notation: H^n := μHE[n]; G(N,n) := Grassmannian N n; p_S := Grassmannian.project S (orthogonal projection onto S.plane); t_P(S) := ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap(projectionLinearMap S − projectionLinearMap P)‖ (operator norm of p_S − p_P); μ_W := W.weight; ‖δW‖ := variationMeasure W; v(T) := planeVarifoldMeasure T; B_ρ(y) := closedBall y ρ, B°_ρ(y) := ball y ρ; unitBallVolume n is the extended-real volume of the open unit ball of ℝ^n; ofReal := ENNReal.ofReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (χ : Euclidean N → ℝ), Continuous χ → HasCompactSupport χ → ∃ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), (∀ (z : Euclidean N) (S : Grassmannian N n), f (z, S) = χ z * ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap S - Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap P)‖) ∧ tsupport f ⊆ tsupport χ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))
